verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows a first-party natural-language command interface or AI assistant in Logseq. Slash commands, `{{query}}` simple queries, the logseq:// protocol and the local HTTP API are structured syntax or programmatic interfaces, not natural-language control. The one community remark about using Claude or Codex to write pages describes external agents editing files, which the user says the new version no longer allows; it is not the product being operated by natural language.
